meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: "The Evaluation Article of the CBA is intended to comply with the requirements of the California Education Code."\n"Part-time Employment - Unit members employed on a part-time basis shall be paid in accordance with Education Code 45025."\n"Special education and support staff who complete the specialized SB 1969 training shall be eligible for and receive three (3) semester units."
